item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Berates Allies While Signaling He Will Wind Down the War
item.summary: President Trump said that he was considering leaving NATO over allies’ failure to support his Iran offensive. He suggested that the U.S. war would end in two or three weeks and that Iran’s closure of the Strait of Hormuz would be a problem for others to solve.

item.title: Israel’s Message to Southern Lebanon: Shiites Must Go
item.summary: Israel has issued sweeping evacuation warnings, and pressed some Christian and Druse leaders to expel Shiite Muslims from their towns, the leaders said.

item.title: The Sailors Stranded in the Persian Gulf
item.summary: Thousands of civilian sailors have been stranded for more than a month in waters surrounded by a conflict zone because of the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: French Prosecutors Link Foiled Attack on American Bank to a Pro-Iranian Group
item.summary: The group is suspected of involvement in a string of attacks on Jewish targets in Belgium, Britain and the Netherlands.

item.title: 29 Killed in Russian Military Plane Crash in Crimea
item.summary: Investigators cited a possible technical malfunction.

item.title: Europe Has a ‘Guns vs. Butter’ Problem. War in Iran Makes It Worse.
item.summary: After decades of prioritizing domestic over military spending, the continent’s leaders are trying to pivot. That is straining national budgets and could anger voters.

item.title: Israelis Prepare to Celebrate Passover in Shadow of War
item.summary: The atmosphere during preparations for the Jewish festival has been unusually subdued, with people afraid to stray far from their homes and shelters.

item.title: Trump Says U.S. Will Be Out of Iran Within Two to Three Weeks
item.summary: The White House said the president would address the nation about Iran on Wednesday evening.

item.title: In UK Prisons, Drones Fly In Contraband ‘As if by Uber Eats’
item.summary: Decades-old prison buildings were designed to be secure from the ground but not the air. Experts say that makes a lucrative smuggling trade hard to tackle.

item.title: U.S. Plans Military Expansion in Greenland
item.summary: The Pentagon is in talks with Denmark for access to three more areas on the Arctic island. Several Greenlanders said they didn’t like the idea.
